name: mnote_list_pages
description: List the page tree of one notebook (by `notebook` slug). Returns page summaries (no bodies): id, parent_page_id (null at root), title, slug, position, is_favorite, updated_at. Use the `parent_page_id`/`slug` to understand nesting and to find a page's slug before mnote_get_page / mnote_update_page / mnote_delete_page.
